artifact.aom-atlantean.aomBookOfGaia.eve: A book grows in the hollow of an old tree. Vines creep out from under the bronze leaves of its cover, wind around your outstretched hand, and slowly let go. This is the Book of Gaia.
artifact.aom-atlantean.aomCheiroballista:
{Cheiroballista}

In battle the Cheiroballista shoots at enemy troops, and its damage grows with the hero's Attack. A hero who has learned Artillery can aim it personally.

An unattended bolt thrower stands by the road, fresh cord still wound on its winch, its wheel ruts leading off towards the distant shore. You have it hauled into your column. This is a Cheiroballista of Atlantis.
artifact.aom-atlantean.aomCrownOfRheia.e: In an abandoned temple the stone statue of the mother of the gods still wears a golden crown shaped like battlements. You bow to the statue before you take it down. This is the Crown of Rheia.
artifact.aom-atlantean.aomPeltOfArgus.ev: A herdsman has spread a hide over a rock as his bedding, yet the eye-shaped markings on it turn to follow you as you walk. You trade a bag of gold for it. This is the Pelt of Argus.
artifact.aom-atlantean.aomSickleOfKronos: A sickle stands aslant in the silt of an undersea rift, its edge so black that it gives back no light. As you grasp it, the currents around you slow by a beat. This is the Sickle of Kronos.
artifact.aom-atlantean.aomStarVeilOfOran: A deep blue cloth lies draped over the altar on the summit, and even by day you can see the stars on it drifting slowly. You put it around your shoulders, and the night sky seems to sink lower. This is the Star Veil of Oranos.
artifact.aom-atlantean.aomTitanLegacy.de:
{Titan Legacy}

+4 Attack, +2 Defense, +3 Spell Power, +4 Knowledge.
Your troops get +1 Speed, +2 Hit Points, +1 Morale and +1 Luck.
Provides 500 gold and 1 Crystal per day, restores 2 extra Spell Points and gives +2 scouting radius.
+10% Echo chance for Atlantean god powers.
Three Aspects: the damage bonus of ascendant troops is increased by a further 10%; in the first round of every battle Sky, Time and Earth are all ascendant.

Combines the Sickle of Kronos, Star Veil of Oranos, Book of Gaia, Crown of Rheia, Torches of Hekate, Pelt of Argus and Titans' Treasure.
(The components are consumed when combined.)
artifact.aom-atlantean.aomTitanLegacy.ev: The seven relics begin to move before you of their own accord: the sickle stands in the middle, and the veil, the book, the crown, the torches, the pelt and the bronze chest circle it in three rings until they fuse into a disc of orichalcum, on which the stars, the hourglass and the leaves each begin to shine. You have obtained the Titan Legacy.
artifact.aom-atlantean.aomTitansTreasure: Deep in a half-collapsed vault sits a bronze chest. The orichalcum ingots and crystals inside are stacked as neatly as if they had been put there yesterday. This is the Titans' Treasure.
artifact.aom-atlantean.aomTorchesOfHekat: Two crossed torches stand at a three-way crossroads. No one feeds them, yet they burn with a cold white flame. As you draw near, you hear your own footsteps coming down all three roads at once. These are the Torches of Hekate.

building.aom-atlantean.aomAtlantean.spec:
The Patron Temple gives each visiting hero one blessing, according to the patron god the hero serves:
heroes of Kronos get +1 Attack, heroes of Oranos +1 Spell Power, heroes of Gaia +1 Knowledge, and all other heroes +1 Defense.
During sieges the Titan Cycle starts from the Aspect of the defending hero's patron god.
You lay your offering before the altar of Kronos, and the Master of Time grants you a keener edge. (+1 Attack)
You lay your offering before the altar of Oranos, and the Lord of the Heavens grants you divine might. (+1 Spell Power)
You lay your offering before the altar of Gaia, and Mother Earth grants you wisdom. (+1 Knowledge)
The three Titan gods do not know you, but the stone walls of the temple put your heart at ease. (+1 Defense)
The Sky Passage lets heroes travel instantly between your Atlantis towns.

faction.aom-atlantean.aomAtlantean.descr:
{Atlantis}
Alignment: Neutral, Lawful
Native Terrain: Grass
Location: Enroth - the Atlantis Isles in the Western Ocean
Atlantis is the kingdom of the ten kings in the ocean west of Enroth, its capital Poseidonia ringed by three canals. The Atlanteans once revered the god of the sea; later they turned their backs on the Olympians to serve the three Titans Kronos, Oranos and Gaia, and with divine power and ingenuity they command automatons and creatures of myth. After the home island sank beneath the sea, the survivors rebuilt their ring-shaped cities on many shores, where they await the return of the Titans.

mapObject.aom-atlantean.creatureBank.aom: The ground has split open, and something is crawling in the red glow of the lava. This is a rift into the underworld, and the monsters inside will not let anyone walk off with what is theirs. Do you want to go down?
Only cooled rock and the remains of monsters are left in the rift. Someone has been here before you.
The things in the gap come leaping out one after another, and one after another they fall. When the rift grows quiet, you pick the gold they were guarding out of the charred rubble.
The fiends retreat into the depths. Lumps of crystal are set in the lava-lit cracks, and beside them lies a purse left by some unknown traveler.
The last Argus closes every one of its eyes. On the ledge where it coiled you find gold, and a trinket it had been staring at all along.
Every guard in the depths of the rift has fallen, and a sullen growl rises from below. Behind the rubble sits a bronze chest; the orichalcum ingots inside are still warm.
rumor.aom-atlantean.aomAtlanteanGeneralR: They say there is a god power that takes an enemy war machine apart backwards into a heap of parts, but it is no use at all against the living.
My cousin says he saw someone plant a tree of golden apples on a battlefield. Hamadryads guarded it, and his own troops caught their breath every single round.
I hear some can make a Tartarian Gate push up out of the ground. When it opens, everything around it gets singed, friend and foe alike, and things come crawling out of it.
If you see everything in the middle of the field being sucked towards one point, send in your flyers and your level 7 giants at once. That trick does not work on them.
There is a trap the enemy cannot see once it is buried. Whoever steps on it gets dragged down by a great spider and can hardly move for a good while.
They say the one who wears the golden crown of battlements is never short of money, and his soldiers are in unusually high spirits.
Bring the seven things the Titans left behind together and they fuse into a disc by themselves, but once joined they can never be taken apart again.
Someone picked up two torches of cold fire at a three-way crossroads. Ever since, the god powers he casts often sound a second time.
A sailor told me of a hide whose eye markings turn to follow people. Whoever wears it sees farther than anyone else.
They say that once the Echo of Atlantis is fully mastered, six god powers out of ten sound once more, though the second time carries only half the force.
rumor.aom-atlantean.aomAtlanteanRumor0.t: Lava Titans, Sickle Titans and Moss Titans are the most powerful creatures of Atlantis.
rumor.aom-atlantean.aomAtlanteanRumor1.t: I hear the people of Atlantis will dig the Nine-Ring Canal Capital in honor of the hero who brings them the Grail.
A hero of Atlantis who visits the Patron Temple receives one blessing, according to the patron god he serves.
I hear there are Sky Passages between the towns of Atlantis. A hero takes one step and is in another town.
When Kronos leads the army, Time stays ascendant for two rounds in a row.
For heroes who serve Gaia, the Lush Ground underfoot heals more.
rumor.aom-atlantean.aomAtlanteanRumor2.t: Legend has it that Atlantis was once the kingdom of the ten kings in the ocean west of Enroth. Only after the home island sank did the survivors scatter to many shores and rebuild their ring-shaped cities.
rumor.aom-atlantean.aomAtlanteanRumor3.t: They say the Atlanteans stopped worshipping the Olympians long ago. The ones they serve are the three Titans: Kronos, Oranos and Gaia.
rumor.aom-atlantean.aomAtlanteanRumor4.t: Every Atlantean soldier bears one of the three Aspects of Sky, Time and Earth. Whichever Aspect is ascendant in a round, its soldiers are both fast and fierce.
rumor.aom-atlantean.aomAtlanteanRumor5.t: An enemy singled out by a Winged Longbowman is marked with the Sky Eye. However far the shot, even over a wall, arrows hit it at full strength.
rumor.aom-atlantean.aomAtlanteanRumor6.t: Do not let a Sickle Titan cut you three times in a row: each cut slows you a little more, and at three stacks you cannot move at all that round.
rumor.aom-atlantean.aomAtlanteanRumor7.t: Grass and trees spring up wherever a Moss Titan has stood. Wounds slowly close on friends who step there, while enemies get their feet tangled in the roots.
rumor.aom-atlantean.aomAtlanteanRumor8.t: Soldiers standing on lush grass need not fear having their time locked.
rumor.aom-atlantean.aomAtlanteanRumor9.t: An old soldier told me that when an army has all four of Sky, Time, Earth and Mortal, the stack turned hero can strike one more time in a round.
